label: Mecha
description: Piloted or autonomous large machines; engineering, embodiment and responsibility.

label: Isekai
description: Displacement into another world; adaptation, changed social rules and identity.

label: Slice of Life
description: Everyday work, school, home and community; small stakes can carry deep meaning.

label: Horror
description: Fear, dread, uncanny humans, monsters, isolation and threatened safety.

label: Romance
description: Attraction, boundaries, intimacy and romantic conflict across genders.

label: Sports
description: Athletic training, teams, competition and sporting achievement; includes motorsport formerly Racing.

label: Cyberpunk
description: Networked power, artificial identity, augmentation and corporate technology.

label: Fantasy
description: Invented worlds with extraordinary rules, cultures or creatures; not synonymous with every myth.

label: Idol
description: Performance, rehearsal, fandom, manufactured image and entertainment-industry relationships.

label: Mystery
description: Investigation, evidence and revelation; noir remains an aesthetic within this and other genres.

label: Comedy
description: Timing, absurdity, social observation and character-driven humour.

label: Cooking
description: Food craft, hospitality, kitchens, culinary rivalry and the communities around meals.

label: Military
description: Command, service, strategy, logistics and armed institutions; not all action is military.

label: Supernatural
description: Spirits and unexplained forces interacting with lived reality; need not be frightening.

label: Space
description: Space travel, orbital habitats, alien societies and the scale and isolation of the cosmos.

label: Magical
description: Spellcraft, transformations and magical ability; all genders and species, not only magical girls.

label: Survival
description: Wilderness, apocalypse, disaster, hostile environments, expeditions, isolation, resource scarcity and survival communities.

label: Pirate
description: Seafaring adventure, treasure, outlaw crews, privateers, naval conflict, exploration and swashbuckling; airship variants still require a piracy-based world.

label: Martial Arts
description: Hand-to-hand combat, fighting disciplines, dojos, tournament combat, martial schools, masters, students and combat philosophy.

label: Mythology
description: Gods, demigods, divine monsters, legendary heroes and world religious/mythic traditions adapted as grand narrative; never restricted to Norse material.

label: Nordic
description: Scandinavian/Norse-inspired worlds, sagas, Viking-era aesthetics, northern clans, longships, runes, fjords, shield societies and folklore; grounded politics qualify without gods.
